nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UV Control Sunscreen SPF 50 with Azelaic Acid

avis.texte: blends in well (very waterly) does NOT leave white cast/strikes does NOT burn eyes

This is the only sunscreen I have ever found that doesn't burn my skin/eyes when I wear it. It also doesn't break me out! I have v sensitive/reactive skin and eczema. I have never been able to consistently apply sunscreen bc of all the issues I normally encounter before I found this formula.

I wanted to love this sunscreen but I found it too greasy to wear comfortably without powdering my face. I also feel that this deterred me from reapplying it as recommended. Also not happy that I bought this product in late January and it expires in August. I'd recommend checking the expiration date before purchasing.

I was heartbroken to see people don't like this. I came back to the sight to buy a second bottle, and noticed the bad reviews. I have acne prone skin and rosacea, and this is magic! One, it actually protects against the sun (was in the sun for three hours and no burns!). Two, it didn't break me out (everythingggg breaks me out). And even my husband said my redness is so much better. Please NEVER STOP MAKING THIS!
Broke me out so badly! Gave a nice dewy look but not worth the awful acne it caused
This is a truly fragrance free product and it feels good on my skin. It builds on too of my rosacea cream and under makeup without issue or pilling and seems to be an effective SPF.

avis.titre: wish there was a jumbo size of this 😔
avis.texte: one of the few sunscreens ive tried that doesnt burn my corneans off ...but idk if its because this isnt wateproof ? the azealic acid does cause a bit of tinglining when i apply it but it goes away after a minute. i would buy it if its on sale again lol
Finally an amazing sunscreen that hydrates, doesn't pill, isn't too greasy and doesn't sing the eyes. I can literally smother this around my eyes and it doesn't sting.

I have acne prone, sensitive and combination skin. I have tried an endless amount of sunscreens and hated all of them because they either caused breakouts, were too greasy, or too drying, pilled, etc. I gave this a shot thinking it's going to be another return but I kid you not, there is absolutely nothing bad I can say about this sunscreen. It's hydrating but lightweight. It doesn't cause breakouts and calms my redness. It doesn't pill and wears wonderfully alone or under makeup. I finally found the one. I have some sun damaged from never wearing sunscreen because I hated them all. I can finally use this every single day, feel protected and enjoy it without causing any kind of irritation. I hope they don't ever stop making this one.

I've tried well over 20 sunscreens as I wear sunscreen daily and have for the past decade. I'm very pale and use retinol so it's crucial. I love this sunscreen. It doesnt break me out and I am acne prone. Very gentle. Never stings or burns skin or eyes. I've fully used one bottle and have another one started now. I think this is hands down the best American sunscreen I've ever used and the only one I care to have. I still prefer European sunscreen, but this is top notch for American.
Im sooooo happy i found this its amazing and blends well also does NOT sting eyes. I hope they keep this forever!!!
Love the addition of azelaic acid, helps calm my acne and eczema flare ups. No white casts at all and this sunscreen blends so well!

I have tried countless sunscreens and have wasted hundreds if not thousands of dollars. My skin is extremely acne prone and sensitive, and I have rosacea. Most sunscreens break me out, and the ones that don't break me out either burn, cause itchy reactions, or turn my face bright red. This sunscreen does none of those things! I left it on all day and did not break out or have any issues with it burning. My skin looks hydrated and glowy with no white cast (I have fair skin with pink undertones). I avoided sunscreen for so long because of all the issues it caused. I hope La Rosche Posay never gets rid of this!! I will continue to rebuy it and recommend to others with acne and rosacea.

Are you kidding me - this is supposedly for oily skin probe to breakouts? This is VERY shiny and sticky. It looks terrible and feels terrible. I'm glad other ppl like it, its just not for me. I would not recommend it if you have large pores. It will make your pores look even larger.

avis.titre: If I could give this more than 5 stars—I would!
avis.texte: I have tried what feels like ALL sunscreens under the sun for my face. 13 years in the desert sun and not a drop of SPF on my face, because I can't stand the smell or texture of even my most fave drugstore or clinical brands. Then along comes this ACTUALLY invisible, ACTUALLY not-greasy option. Kinda shocked it's at a 4.2 overall right now... people will be sleeping on the world's best sunscreen.
Great for days my skin needs some extra hydration! Provides sun protection and moisture without clogging pores.
It does not white cast or burn like most suncreens do. You need this.
I tried because i have rosacea and im trying to replace dermalogica spf 50 because its expensive but i love it, and this one did not make the cut. Very sticky.
